paite: Huan, Israel suante, omkhawm tengteng huai kha khatna in Zin gamdai a lut ua: huan, mipite'n Kades ah giahbuk a sat uh; huai ah Miriam a si a, huai ah a vui uh.
english: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month: and the people stayed in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

paite: Huan, omkhawmte'n tui a neikei ua; Mosi leh Aron tungtang thu ah a kikhawm ek ua,
english: There was no water for the congregation: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

paite: Huan, mipi in, TOUPA ma a i unaute a sih lai un Pathian in honna hihlum geih ta mai leh aw!
english: The people strove with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!

paite: Bang ding a TOUPA mipite si ding a gamdai a pilut na hia, kou leh ka gante utoh?
english: Why have you brought the assembly of Yahweh into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?

paite: Bangziak in ahia hiai gam hoih lou pi a hon pilut ding a Aigupta gam a kipan non pawtsak mahmah? Buh-leh-balte, theipite, grep kungte, pomgranette omlouhna mun ahi, tui dawn ding mahmah lah a om sam kei hi, chi in Mosi a sual ek ua.
english: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”

paite: Huan, Mosi leh Aron mipi lak a kipan kihoupihna puan inn kongkhak ah a hoh ua, a khupboh ua; huan, TOUPA thupina a kiang uah a hong kilang a,
english: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces: and the glory of Yahweh appeared to them.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi a houpih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: Chiang la inla, omkhawmte omkhawm sak inla, nang leh na unau Aron toh, huai suangpi a mitmuh ua a tui pawtsak ding in hilh in; suangpi a kipan tui na lakkhiak sak ding; huchi in omkhawmte leh a gante na dawnsak ding hi, chi in.
english: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it give forth its water; and you shall bring forth to them water out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in TOUPA ma a kipan chiang a thupiak bang in a la a.
english: Moses took the rod from before Yahweh, as he commanded him.

paite: Mosi leh Aron in omkhawmte suangpi bul ah a omkhawm sak ua, a kiang uah, Helhatte aw, ngai un, hiai suangpi a kipan tui ko'n lakkhiak sak ding uh hia? a chi ua.
english: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels; shall we bring you water out of this rock for you?”

paite: Huan, Mosi in a ban a zak a, suangpi achiang in nihvei a sat a; huchi in tui a hong pawt zuazua a, omkhawmte leh a gante un a dawn uhi.
english: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice: and water came forth abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their livestock.

paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aron kiang ah, No'n gintak louh ua Israel suante mitmuh a no'n pahtawi louh ziak un hiai omkhawmte ka piak gamah na pilut kei ding uhi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”

paite: Hiai Meriba tuite ahi: Israel suanten TOUPA a sual ek ua, huailai a pahtawi a a om tak ziak in, a chi a.
english: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.

paite: Huan, Mosi in Kades a kipan in Edom kumpipa kiang ah mi a sawl a, Na unaupa Israel in hichi bang in a chi, Ka tung ua thuakna hongtung tengteng na thei a:
english: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the travail that has happened to us:

paite: Ka pipute uh Aigupta gam a a hohsuk ua, sawtpi Aigupta gam a ka om bang uh, Aigupta mite'n kou leh ka pipute hoihlou tak a hon bawl bang uh:
english: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians dealt ill with us, and our fathers:

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ka sam ua, ka aw uh a na za a, angel a hon sawl a, Aigupta gam a kipan a hon pikhia a: huan, ngai in, na gam naihpen khua Kades ah ka om ua;
english: and when we cried to Yahweh, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and brought us forth out of Egypt: and behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of your border.

paite: Hehpihtak in na gam ka tawn paisuak ding uh aw: lou hiam, grep huan khawng ah hiam ka pai kei ding ua, tuileh tuite leng ka dawnsak kei ding uh: kumpipa lamlian ah ka pai zel ding ua, na gam ka khen masiah uh taklam hiam, veilam hiam ah leng ka pial kei ding uh, a chi a.
english: “Please let us pass through your land: we will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go along the king’s highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”

paite: Huan, Edom in a kiang ah, No'n palsuak ding ahi kei, no'n pal leh hon sual ding in namsau toh ka hong kuan ding, a chi a.
english: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”

paite: Huchi in Israel suante'n a kiang ah, Lamlian ah ka paitou ding ua; huan, kou leh ka gan un na tui ka dawn uh leh a man ko'n pe ding uh: thil dang bangmah hih lou in a pai in ka paisuak mai ding uh, a chi ua.
english: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink of your water, I and my livestock, then will I give its price: let me only, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”

paite: Huan, aman, Paisuak lou ding, a chi a. Huchi in Edom mipite tampi toh, mihat taktakte toh amau sual ding in a hong kuan ta a.
english: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.

paite: Edom in Israel mite a gam a a pai uh a phalta kei; huchi in Israel mite'n a kiksan nawnta uhi.
english: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.

paite: Huchi in Kades a kipan in a pawt ua; Israel suante, mipi tengteng in Hor tang a vapha uh.
english: They traveled from Kadesh: and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

paite: Huan, TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aron, Edom gam naih Hor tang ah a houpih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

paite: Aron pen a chipihte kiang a pi ahi ding: Meriba tuite a ka thu nang a na hel ziak un Israel suante ka piak gamah a lut sin kei hi.
english: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

paite: Aron leh a tapa Eleazar Hor tang ah hon pitou in:
english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

paite: Aron pen a puansilhte hawk sak inla, a tapa Eleazar silh sak in: Aron pen a chipihte kiang a pi ahi ding, huailai ah a si ding, chi in.
english: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be taken, and shall die there.”

paite: Huan, Mosi in TOUPA thupiak bang in a hih a: mipi tengteng mitmuh in Hor tang ah a paitou ua.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded: and they went up into Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Aron puansilh a hawk sak a, Eleazar a silh sak a: huan, Aron pen mualvum ah a sita: huan, Mosi leh Eleazar mual a kipan a paisuk uhi.Huan, mipi tengteng in Aron a si chih a theih un, Israelte tengteng in ni sawmthum a sun uhi.
english: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there on the top of the mountain: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

paite: Huan, mipi tengteng in Aron a si chih a theih un, Israelte tengteng in ni sawmthum a sun uhi.
english: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
